suppress.notes: Transitive dependency of io.quarkus:quarkus-vertx (via Quarkus platform 3.37.3), not a direct dependency. CVE-2026-44891, CVE-2026-55831, and CVE-2026-55833 are in Netty's STOMP (io.netty.handler.codec.stomp) and SPDY (io.netty.handler.codec.spdy) frame decoders. This application never constructs a STOMP or SPDY server/client and does not expose those protocols; it only uses Netty as the HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/2 transport underlying the Quarkus Vert.x HTTP server. Matched by CPE rather than packageUrl because dependency-check correlates this CVE against every jar sharing the netty:netty CPE (both netty-transport and netty-transport-classes-epoll were observed flagged across different scan runs, depending on which jar the tool picks as the CPE match target). Revisit when the Quarkus platform version is next upgraded, in case the bundled Netty version changes.

False positive: these CVEs are against "OpenTelemetry-Go", the Go language implementation of OpenTelemetry, not the Java io.opentelemetry.semconv artifact pulled in transitively by Quarkus's OpenTelemetry/Micrometer integration. Dependency-check's CPE matching cross-matches the shared "opentelemetry" product name across ecosystems; this project has no Go dependencies of any kind. The specific CVE IDs returned against this CPE have shifted between scan runs (CVE-2026-29181/CVE-2026-39883 on one run, CVE-2026-39882/CVE-2026-41178 on another) even though the underlying jar version did not change, so all four observed IDs are listed here; revisit and prune to only the IDs the NVD dataset currently returns next time this file is touched.

Transitive dependency of io.quarkus:quarkus-virtual-threads (via Quarkus platform 3.37.3), not a direct dependency. CVE-2026-15075 and CVE-2026-15076 are in Vert.x's Web Client (io.vertx.ext.web.client.WebClient / WebClientSession) redirect and cookie-domain handling. This backend never uses vertx-web-client to make outbound HTTP requests (confirmed: no WebClient/WebClientSession usage anywhere in backend/src); vertx-core and vertx-auth-common here only back the inbound Quarkus HTTP server. Matched by CPE rather than packageUrl because dependency-check correlates this CVE against every jar sharing the eclipse:vert.x CPE (vertx-core and vertx-auth-common were both observed flagged across different scan runs). Revisit when the Quarkus platform version is next upgraded.
